scope: Prove a volume-scaled lowest-mode conditional curvature theorem on all separable BT backgrounds, exhibit an exact orthogonal correlated fixture obstructing the naive all-background remainder-sign extension, and preserve the open all-background, annealed-center, interacting H-minus-one, continuum, Born, Krein, and Lorentzian boundaries.

commands.command: ulimit -v 500000; python3 -m py_compile <three scoped Python paths>

commands.output: independent exact enumeration, strict schema, provenance hashes, and boundary checks

tier_2.criterion: The change introduces an isolated action-Hessian theorem and exact finite fixture. It changes no shared operator, classical import, sampler, schema consumed by another certificate chain, or generated foundational input.

tier_3.criterion: No all-background estimate, integrated Gibbs marginal, interacting H-minus-one estimate, tightness, continuum theorem, lifecycle promotion, freeze, shared-core algebra, or release is claimed.

memory_receipt.policy: All Python and TeX commands ran sequentially under a 500000 KiB virtual-memory ceiling; the Go conformance rail uses GOMEMLIMIT=300MiB and GOGC=50 without the incompatible shell virtual-address cap.

recorded_nonpass.command: ulimit -v 500000; GOMEMLIMIT=300MiB GOGC=50 sfc conform planning/work-items
recorded_nonpass.reason: The Go runtime could not reserve page-summary virtual address space because the preceding Python JSON checks shared the same shell virtual-memory ceiling; no repository write occurred.
recorded_nonpass.disposition: Reran in a fresh shell with the Go heap controls and without the incompatible virtual-address cap; the rerun passed CLEAN.
